notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 support-service surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador APIs and standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies public name/handle lookup, normalization, encoding and decoding, available-dimension, order, transportation, and update-rate boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador public support-service lookup, handle conversion, normalization, and lifecycle-boundary declarations
